spec_dod.text: POST /jobs enqueues a background export job and the response body reports `queued: true`.
The job-status page's wording is easy for a non-technical user to follow.
Cancelling a queued job via DELETE /jobs/<id> before it starts prevents it from appearing in the completed-jobs log.
